item.title: Good Morning Family - 18 June 2026
item.description:
Wake up Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Thursday, the 18 June.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be stormy, with a low of 10 degrees and a top of 14 degrees.
There is about a 100 percent chance of rain.
You might need a raincoat today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is M.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter M?
. . . . . . . . . . .
